history.overview: The Chambers were once Dragorn burial vaults, later seized for Muramite experimentation.

timeline.name: Burial Vault Era
timeline.description: Dragorn ancestors were interred in these chambers.

timeline.name: Muramite Conversion
timeline.description: Muramite inquisitors converted the vaults into torture halls.

timeline.name: Discord Rituals
timeline.description: Discord rituals corrupted the chambers, animating the dead.

timeline.name: Resistance Attempts
timeline.description: Dragorn resistance attempted to sabotage Muramite operations.
